latest_cos_commentary.headline: TipHaus is a tip-pooling, distribution, and payroll-integration tool for restaurants that sits on top of existing POS systems rather than replacing them.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Adjacent to Genius's back_office line (payroll/labor-adjacent tooling); does not compete on core pos or payments.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No dated 2025-2026 news or funding activity was found in this pass.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Frame as a point solution for tip management that a prospect may run alongside any POS, including Genius; not a full back-office replacement.
